    data = input().split()
    
    k = int(data[0])
    q = data[1]
    
    if len(set(q)) < k:
        print("NO")
        return
    
    char_count = Counter(q)
    used_chars = set()
    result = []
    
    for _ in range(k):
        found = False
        for char in q:
            if char not in used_chars and char_count[char] > 0:
                used_chars.add(char)
                char_count[char] -= 1
                start_index = q.index(char)
                result.append(q[start_index:])
                q = q[:start_index] + q[start_index+1:]
                found = True
                break
        if not found:
            print("NO")
            return
    
    print("YES")
    for s in result:
        print(s)
